title: Research Scientist, Junior Research Fellow and Project Associate – 16 Posts
qualification: Research Scientist:First Class M.Sc./M.Tech/M.Sc.(Tech) or equivalent postgraduate degree in the relevant discipline (Geology, Computer Science, Disaster Management, Environmental Science, or Atmospheric Science, depending on post code), along with one year of research/work experience in the specified field. A Ph.D. in the relevant field is considered desirable experience for most Research Scientist posts. || Junior Research Fellow:First Class M.Sc./M.Tech or equivalent postgraduate degree (or B.E./B.Tech for certain computer science posts) in the relevant discipline, along with a valid NET/GATE or equivalent qualification. || Project Associate-I:First Class M.Sc. in Botany/Forestry/Environmental Science or equivalent discipline, along with a minimum of one year of experience in plant identification. || Candidates must clearly mention, with supporting proof, any specialization, dissertation, or thesis in the relevant field wherever applicable, as this is required for their application to be considered.
salary: Candidates checking the NESAC Research Scientist salary, NESAC JRF salary, or NESAC Project Associate salary can refer to the fixed monthly emoluments below, along with applicable allowances. || Junior Research Fellows and Project Associates-I are eligible only for casual leave, while Research Scientists are eligible for leave as per the institution's rules. Maternity leave, as per Government of India instructions, is available to all female Research Scientists and JRFs. Apart from these, selected candidates will not be entitled to any benefits or concessions admissible to regular employees. || Also Read: Calculate your exact in-hand Salary in 10 seconds - Calculate Now
age_limit: Age relaxation of 5 years is available for SC/ST candidates and 3 years for OBC candidates. Ex-servicemen and Persons with Disabilities are eligible for age relaxation as per Government of India orders, and candidates claiming any relaxation must submit valid documentary proof. The date of interview will be treated as the cut-off date for age, qualification, and all other eligibility purposes.
selection_process: Only candidates who possess the required qualification as on the date of interview should attend. || The prescribed experience will be considered valid only if gained after acquiring the essential qualification. || Selection is entirely at the discretion of the interview panel based on performance on the day.
